'''Cereans''' were a sophisticated and cultured [[Humanoid/Legends|humanoid]] [[Mammal/Legends|mammalian]] [[Species/Legends|species]] hailing from the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Cerea/Legends|Cerea]] in the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]]. They were famed for their extraordinary thinking abilities, made possible by large binary brains housed in tall tapering heads, enabling them to focus on many things at the same time. Aside from this unique feature, Cereans were physically similar to [[Human/Legends|Humans]], although they each possessed two hearts, which supplied extra blood circulation to support their brains.

Cereans were often found among the ranks of the [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knights]], but due to the species' low birth rates, Cerean [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] were exempt from the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Order's]] vow of non-attachment.<ref name="SWA3">''[[Star Wars Adventures 3: The Hostage Princess]]''</ref> One such Jedi, [[Ki-Adi-Mundi/Legends|Ki-Adi-Mundi]], served on the [[Jedi High Council/Legends|Jedi High Council]] during and prior to the [[First Battle of Geonosis/Legends|outbreak]] of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].

==Biology and appearance==
[[File:Force_adept_TotG.jpg|thumb|left|180px|A [[Gender/Legends|female]] Cerean [[Force Adept]]]]
The Cereans' enlarged skulls, extending up to twenty centimeters above their foreheads, housed complex binary brains, provided with sufficient blood by an extra heart in their heads.<ref name="E1A15">''[[Episode I Adventures 15: The Final Battle]]''</ref> The binary structure of Cerean thinking helped them to ponder two sides of an issue at once.<ref name="NEGAS" /> It also enabled them to process information and solve problems rapidly<ref name="UAA" /> and provided a highly advanced capacity for concentration and meditation. Because of their thoughtful nature, they tended to be calm, rational and analytical, preferring peaceful philosophies and a lifestyle which worked in harmony with nature. Though the quick-thinking Cereans had equally quick reflexes, they were commonly not as well coordinated as Humans.<ref name="UAA" /> Because of the weight of their enlarged skulls, Cereans often had back problems<ref name="Death Star novel">[[Death Star (novel)|''Death Star'']]</ref> and were less physically coordinated than the average [[Human/Legends|Human]].<ref name="FaD" />

Cereans were a sexually dimorphic species, with male Cereans aging more rapidly than their female counterparts. Additionally, males were outnumbered by females due to a skewed birth rate ratio of twenty females to every one male. [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitivity]] among Cereans was similar to that of baseline Humans, with Cereans training as both [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] and [[Sith/Legends|Sith]]. Their binary brains, it was suggested, allowed some Cerean Forcefuls to explore both the [[Light side of the Force/Legends|light]] and [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark aspects]] of [[The Force/Legends|the Force]].<ref name="FaD" />

==Society and culture==
[[File:Chapter_IV_Talents_FDCR.png|thumb|right|200px|A male Cerean uses the Force to heal his wounded arm.]]
Cereans developed a low&ndash;tech society on their [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] and preferred to live in isolation from the wider [[The galaxy/Legends|galaxy]]. Preserving the natural beauty of Cerea, the planet was home to many [[Outsider Citadel/Legends|Outsider Citadels]] where it was permissible to use offworld technology, though it could not be removed from the Citadel. Beyond the Citadels, offworld technology was strictly prohibited, especially that which could harm the planet's ecosystem.<ref name="FaD" /> [[Meditation/Legends|Meditation]] was a core part of a Cerean's daily rituals, with many employing specially-forged [[kasha]] crystals as a focusing tool. By focusing one's thoughts while in contact with such crystals, distractions were eliminated, creating an exceptional meditation environment. Cerean [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] sometimes incorporated these crystals into their lightsabers, providing great focus, even during intense physical combat.<ref name="UAA" />

Because of the dimorphism in the species, the government of Cerea was matriarchal. The governing [[Council of Elders (Cerea)|Council of Elders]] was led by a president who made decisions based on the advice of the Council. Decisions made by the Council were considered to be infallible and appeals were unheard of.<ref name="FaD" /> During the years leading up to the [[Invasion of Naboo/Legends|Invasion of Naboo]], a generational dispute erupted on Cerea when the younger generation took up a rebellious stance against their low&ndash;tech society. Many Cerean youths wished to own such technology as was commonplace in the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], like [[Starship/Legends|starships]] and [[Speeder bike/Legends|speeder bikes]]. This unrest was ultimately quelled by [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Ki-Adi-Mundi/Legends|Ki-Adi-Mundi]], who traced the instigator of the movement, [[Ephant Mon/Legends|Ephant Mon]], to [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]].<ref name="PtR">''[[Star Wars: Prelude to Rebellion]]''</ref>

The traditional nature of the Cerean community was reflected in their names, which were broken into three hyphenated parts. The names were derivatives of an individual's parents and grandparents. The clothing worn by most Cereans was based on a traditional style that carried on over the centuries. Martial arts was a focused and stylized part of many Cereans' lives, with the use of the ancient [[shyarn]] as a means of moving through aggression.<ref name="FaD" /> [[Polygamy|Polygamous]] marriage was a necessity in order for the species to survive, due to its sexual dimorphism. Each male usually had one primary "[[bond-wife]]," and between four and ten "[[Honor-wife|honor-wives]]." Culturally, Cereans embraced the Force and their knack for analysis allowed them insight that resembled [[Precognition/Legends|precognition]].<ref name="FaD" />

==Cereans in the galaxy==
[[File:KiAdiMundi.jpg|thumb|left|150px|[[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Ki-Adi-Mundi/Legends|Ki-Adi-Mundi]]]]
Ki-Adi-Mundi served as [[Jedi Watchman/Legends|Jedi Watchman]] for his home system, though he relinquished this post during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] to fellow Cerean [[Tarr Seirr]].<ref name="Labyrinth of Evil">''[[Labyrinth of Evil]]''</ref> When Seirr was also called away, the Cereans were left undefended and their planet was attacked by the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]]. The death toll of the [[Battle of Cerea]] reached over one million, and included the family of Ki-Adi-Mundi.<ref name="The New Essential Chronology">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''</ref> This led to the Cereans becoming even more removed from galactic affairs with the rise of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]].<ref name="NEGAS" />

As of [[18 BBY/Legends|18 BBY]], [[Thi Xon Yimmon]] was the head of the [[Whiplash]], a resistance group that specialized in removing individuals such as [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] and political refugees from [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] to areas outside of the Empire's direct influence. Although not a [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] himself, Yimmon lived by many [[Jedi Code/Legends|Jedi ideals]]. <ref name="Coruscant Nights II: Street of Shadows">''[[Coruscant Nights II: Street of Shadows]]''</ref>

By the time of the [[Yuuzhan Vong War]], the Cereans had developed a unique Force tradition, known as the [[Ner Yan]]. This group used the Force to link their minds, although in a haphazard manner. [[Ka-Tu-Un]] was an adept of this tradition and was mistaken for a Jedi by the [[Yuuzhan Vong]].<ref name="hoti">{{GamerCite|8|Hive of the Infidel}}</ref>
